project_title: Design Website for our Franchise Store
question: Combine the pre-task requirement state with the current client task. If the task determines a unique post-task state, choose ACT and construct that state; otherwise choose CLARIFY and identify the blocking requirement field and the question that must be answered.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example
Is our site right now for our Harbor Valley locations, which are Port Averly and Linden Falls
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Ridgehaven, so that one will be opened and called Shatter House, since our brand is Shatter House from now on. So we want to have our master site https://shatterhouse.example to show our brand, locations, and info all in one, with sub links to our locations, but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Thanks for explaining that makes perfect sense.

Using one master website for the Shatter House brand with separate location pages is definitely the right approach. We can keep everything under one website while allowing each location to manage its own Wix Bookings, revenue, and appointments independently.

I also reviewed https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example, and I understand the direction you're looking to take with the new branding and structure. This setup will also make it much easier to add future locations as your franchise grows.

Just one question before we move forward: is https://shatterhouse.example already set up in Wix and you want me to restructure and rebrand the existing site, or would you like me to build the new master site from scratch using your current website as the reference?

That will help me confirm the scope, and if everything aligns, I'm ready to get started right away and keep you updated throughout the project.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: As we begin franchising, we want to integrate additional locations while still giving each of them full control. I want https://shatterhouse.example built from scratch, but using the same kind of template. One of our competitors has the layout we really like: it is simple, lists every location, and is easy to navigate.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
For a growing franchise, this is the right approach in my view. A from-scratch build for https://shatterhouse.example will provide a solid foundation that is much easier to expand as new locations are added. Under the main Shatter House brand, we can give every location its own page while allowing it to continue managing its Wix Bookings, appointments, and business independently.

Before we move forward, I'd also like to review the competitor website you referenced. That review will give me a clear picture of the layout and functionality you want, after which I can confirm the full scope.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Can you confirm that the competitor website you meant is https://rageworksusa.example/?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, that's the one.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before I begin, I want to verify the plan. I’ll reuse the content, images, and booking information from https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example, while the competitor’s site will serve as the design reference for the overall layout, structure, and navigation. The result will be a new website with your own branding. Thanks for confirming—is that correct?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I agree with that plan. My main concern is that once we rebrand, upgrade, and change the website, the SEO for Harbor Valley Shatter House may suffer. What can we do to minimize that damage?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The SEO has to be redone; there isn’t another way.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could we avoid disrupting things by keeping Harbor Valley Shatter House and linking it to the master page, or would that arrangement not be smooth?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Because we’re reusing the existing content and building around the current website, we can reduce the impact on your SEO. We’ll preserve the important SEO elements, handle the transition properly, and plan the migration carefully so it is as smooth as possible.

If you decide to keep https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example, we can link it to the new master website where appropriate. After the new site is ready, I’ll recommend the migration approach that best protects your existing rankings. I wouldn’t be too concerned.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before I proceed, can you confirm that you already own https://shatterhouse.example, that I should build the new website on that domain, and that https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example should remain live throughout the transition?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes—and in addition, I want to make sure the Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley locations stay separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I understand. You want one master website, while every location will operate independently with its own bookings, calendar, payouts, and reporting. I'll choose the appropriate setup to support that.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: With that setup confirmed, could you outline the next steps and process, and let me know what the turnaround will be?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
After discussing the project in detail, I realized that its scope is much larger than originally described. Because this is a brand-new franchise website requiring separate booking and management for every location, the $500 budget wouldn't cover the full project.

Could we discuss a revised budget so I can deliver everything you're looking for?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For the project scope we’ve defined, what price should I expect?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For a brand-new franchise website with a multi-location setup and independent booking management, my typical price would be $1,200. That would not have to be the firm final amount, though; I'm happy to discuss the budget and find an option that works for both of us.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Around $800 is the budget I have available, and I’ll definitely return for future locations!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The website will be structured so future locations are easy to add, and I can complete it within the $800 budget. I appreciate this opportunity and would value working together long-term.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For a project of this size, what completion timeframe should I expect?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: A schedule of 20–28 business days is my estimate for a project of this size. That timeframe allows me to build the new website properly, set up multi-location booking, test everything thoroughly, and complete any revisions that prove necessary.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Before we begin, what do you need from me?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Before I can begin, please provide access to two places: the Wix workspace for https://shatterhouse.example, where I’ll build the new website, and https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example, so I can use the existing content, images, and booking information as the foundation for the new site.

Please also resend the competitor website URL for use as the design reference and provide a list of any additional pages you want included. If https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example does not already contain the content for those pages, please send that material as well.

As soon as I have all the requested access and materials, I can start building the website.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Whenever you’re ready, you can accept the proposal; I’ve already updated it to reflect the $800 budget we discussed. Once it is accepted and everything else is in place, I’ll begin immediately.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: If we do it all in one website, the locations' payouts will be separate, right?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For each location, the bookings, calendars, and reporting can remain separate. Before confirming the payout arrangement, though, I need to review the Wix payment configuration because it depends on whether each franchise receives payments separately or through a single payment account.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Before we proceed, I need clarification on how the payouts will be set up.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Under the Wix setup, one website uses a single payment account, so it wouldn’t support different payout accounts for each location. Bookings, calendars, and reporting can still be managed separately by location, but the payouts would go through the same payment account.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Are you with me.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, that's a problem—every location needs separate payouts. Would we have to create two wix websites, one for the Shatter House MASTER and one for Ridgehaven directly, so it runs separately, and then also connect to Harbor Valley Shatter House on its own wix account so each is controlled and tracked separately?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The approach works for me, but because I’m short on budget, could we complete it for $600? I still want to work with you.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Before we finalize the pricing, I need to clarify the revised scope, though I really do want to work with you. The $800 we discussed covered the https://shatterhouse.example master website. Under the new approach, we would also create a separate Ridgehaven Wix website with its own bookings, payment setup, and management. Because that is an additional website, it is a separate project component that I would normally price at $600.

I wanted to make that clear because the scope has changed from one website to two.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
The revised plan is materially larger than the original scope of one website for $800 because it now includes a second, separate Wix website. Although the design can follow the same structure, the implementation is not simply a matter of copying and pasting. Every site still requires its own Wix setup, booking configuration, payment setup, testing, and location-specific adjustments.

Given that workload, going from $800 for one website to $600 for two websites is too low. Instead, I can build both websites for $1,200 and ensure they are built properly, with a solid foundation for future franchise locations.

I believe that is a fair compromise, and I would genuinely like the opportunity to work with you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Bookings would be handled by the related location websites, so the main site itself would not need any booking system.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Although the designs will be similar, the revised plan involves more work: the original scope was $800 for one website, whereas we are now considering two separate Wix websites. The second site still needs its own setup, configuration, testing, and payment integration, so I cannot go from $800 for one website to $600 for two.

Let’s meet in the middle at $1,000, which I think is a fair compromise for both of us. Can we proceed now?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Because our budget is very tight, could we do it for the original 800?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: We can proceed at $800, and I completely understand the budget constraint. Before we finalize everything, though, could you explain how you envision the second website working? The structure of the master website is clear to me, but I want to understand exactly how the second site should be organized so we agree before moving forward.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please approve the proposal.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: lets start

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please formally accept the proposal.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Access to your website will be necessary for me to proceed.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I understand the access request. Could we schedule a chat to review everything together?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.
